# Standard task card spec (TASK-SPEC v1)

> Languages: **English** | [简体中文](zh/TASK-SPEC.md)

**Applies to**: every `[[task]]` in a maw blueprint, and `.maw/TASK.md` generated by `maw next` into a worktree.

**One-line rule**: **A card is an index, not a document.** It must let an agent learn in five minutes what to do, what to read, how to know it is done, and what not to touch. Details live in files listed in `read_scope`.

---

## 1. Field tiers

| Tier | Field | Definition | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **L1 required** | `id` | Stable unique id; never reuse after merge | Supported |
| **L1** | `title` | Verb-led **deliverable**, ≤30 chars, no open-ended words | Supported |
| **L1** | `goal` | Why this task + what changes when done (≤2 sentences) | Needs extension |
| **L1** | `write_scope` | Paths allowed to edit, ≥1 | Supported |
| **L1** | `acceptance` | ≥1 **decidable** assertions (yes/no) | Supported |
| **L1** | `verify` | ≥1 runnable commands, or `manual: <how>` | Needs extension |
| L2 recommended | `deps` | Prerequisites; drives parallelism | Supported |
| L2 | `read_scope` | Must-read files before starting, ≥1 | Supported (not always rendered on card) |
| L2 | `priority` / `merge_order` | Order keys for same-surface serial work | Supported |
| L2 | `not_doing` | Explicit non-goals | Needs extension |
| L3 optional | `artifact` | Non-code outputs | Needs extension |
| L3 | `size_hint` | Estimated files/LOC for split warnings | Needs extension |
| L3 | `lane` | Module cluster for context affinity | Needs extension |

Fields marked “needs extension” can land in `db.Task.Extra` without a schema migration until parsers grow first-class fields.

---

## 2. L1 judgment rules

### 2.1 `title` — deliverable, not a direction

- Good: concrete outcomes with an endpoint
- Bad: “optimize”, “improve”, “support”, “handle”, “related”, “etc.” — `plan check` should warn on fuzzy-word hits

### 2.2 `goal` — why + observable change

```
goal = "Status: <problem, cite docs/issue>. Goal: <what changes and how you observe it>."
```

### 2.3 `acceptance` — decidable without reading code

Each assertion should name an observation point (API, page, metric).

### 2.4 `verify` — separate proof from the assertion

```toml
verify = [
  "go test ./...",
  "cd web && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit",
]
```

Empty `verify` / `["none"]` is invalid. `manual: …` is allowed when only humans can check UI.

### 2.5 `not_doing` — negative constraints beat long positive prose

```toml
not_doing = ["do not change existing HTTP route signatures", "no new dependencies"]
```

---

## 3. Card render rules (`TASK.md`)

Body **≤ 40 lines**. Fixed sections: Goal, Acceptance, Verify commands, Read first (`read_scope`), Upstream (`deps`), Write scope, Not doing, Protocol.

`read_scope` **must** render on the card. Deps lines should auto-fill title + acceptance from the DB.

---

## 4. `plan check` rules (machine-decidable)

| # | Rule | Level |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `title` hits fuzzy-word blacklist | Warn |
| 2 | Missing `acceptance`, or no observation points | Error |
| 3 | Missing `verify` | Error |
| 4 | Empty `write_scope` | Error |
| 5 | `write_scope` spans ≥3 top-level modules | Warn (split signal) |
| 6 | Shared files without `[shared_files]` | Warn |
| 7 | Wave has zero entry tasks (no deps) | Warn |
| 8 | Deps depth > 8 | Warn |
| 9 | Two tasks write the same file with no mutual `deps` | Warn |
| 10 | Estimated file count > 20 | Warn |

Rules 7–8 should emit a **parallel width report**: depth / entries / width per layer / theoretical max parallel.

---

## 5. Anti-patterns

| Anti-pattern | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| One task, many deliverables | Split scripts vs samples vs docs |
| Undecidable acceptance | Observation points + separate `verify` |
| Huge write_scope | Split or declare `not_doing` |
| One long deps chain | Keep ≥2 entry tasks per wave |
| Card as document | Navigation only; detail in `read_scope` files |
| `Verify:` embedded in acceptance text | Dedicated `verify` field |

---

## 6. Size baseline

Empirical midpoints (~40 merges): ~993 LOC / 3 files / 5.3 minutes. Reasonable band: 200–1,500 LOC, 1–6 files, single module. Split signals: >20 files, >2,000 LOC, ≥3 modules, or multiple verify kinds. Finer is not always better—handoff cost grows.

---

## 7. Compatibility (no code change yet)

| Target field | Interim encoding |
| --- | --- |
| `goal` | First `acceptance` line prefixed `Status:… Goal:…` |
| `verify` | Keep `Verify: <cmd>` prefixes in acceptance text |
| `not_doing` | Trailing acceptance lines prefixed `Don't:` |
| `size_hint` | Omit; infer from post-hoc stats |

Upgrade path: parser fields → enable §4 checks → render four extra card sections → keep interim encodings as fallback.

---

## 8. Rollout order

1. Render four missing card sections (lowest cost).
2. `plan check` rules 2–3.
3. Parallel-width report (rules 7–8).
4. First-class `goal` / `verify` / `not_doing`.
5. Enable remaining warn rules when noise is tolerable.
